scope: Source-checked application overlay; canonical research package preserved. This is not clinical approval.

sengupta-boswellia-2008.locator: Results, Clinical efficacy, Table 4: symptom-score rows have placebo n=23, low-dose n=24, high-dose n=23; abstract Results states 70 completed.
sengupta-boswellia-2008.denominator: Whole-study 90-day clinical symptom analysis (23 + 24 + 23). Biomarker subset denominators differ.
sengupta-boswellia-2008.replacedLimitation: Small trial; 70 completed, but analysis denominator not independently extracted.
analysisLimitations: Small trial; symptom-analysis and biomarker denominators differ.
sengupta-boswellia-2008.claimText: The trial's 90-day clinical symptom table includes 70 participants across its three groups; biomarker analyses used smaller subsets.

chuchalin-pelargonium-2005.locator: Original article, Statistical Analysis, Results on participant flow, and Figure 2 (pp. 439–440).
chuchalin-pelargonium-2005.denominator: Primary symptom-score intention-to-treat analysis across both groups (64 + 60). The study carried forward the last observed score for early withdrawals.
chuchalin-pelargonium-2005.replacedLimitation: Short follow-up; full-text analysis details and funding were not extracted.
analysisLimitations: Short follow-up. The analysis carried forward earlier observations for participants who withdrew.
chuchalin-pelargonium-2005.claimText: The primary symptom-score analysis included 124 participants across both groups, using earlier observations for participants who withdrew.

kasper-lavender-2014.locator: Original article, primary outcome methods and Figure 1, Full analysis set (121 + 135 + 132 + 135).
kasper-lavender-2014.denominator: Full analysis set for the primary anxiety score across both Silexan groups, paroxetine, and placebo.
kasper-lavender-2014.replacedLimitation: Full-text allocation and analysis details were not extracted.
analysisLimitations: The full analysis set excludes participants without post-baseline efficacy data.
kasper-lavender-2014.claimText: The primary anxiety-score analysis included 523 participants across the four study groups.

morishita-2021-constipation.locator: Morishita's Hyogo Medical University dissertation abstract for this trial, Results (結果), first sentence; journal abstract reports 90 completed.
morishita-2021-constipation.denominator: Final analysis included 30 in each of the senna, magnesium oxide, and placebo groups.
morishita-2021-constipation.replacedLimitation: All 90 completed, but explicit analysis count is not separately reported in the abstract.
morishita-2021-constipation.claimText: The trial's final analysis included 90 participants across its three study groups.

rahnama-ginger-2012.locator: Original article, Figure 2, Results and Table 1. The flowchart shows 120 assessed, 118 randomized, and 59 + 46 analyzed.
rahnama-ginger-2012.denominator: Final analysis includes 59 in the ginger group and 46 in the placebo group. The body and flowchart agree; the abstract reports a different ginger group size.
analysisLimitations: Thirteen placebo-group participants did not complete evaluation; the reported count follows the full-text flowchart and Results.
rahnama-ginger-2012.claimText: The trial flowchart shows 120 students assessed for eligibility, 118 randomized, and 105 included in the final analysis. Participants had moderate or severe primary dysmenorrhea.

sun-2020-flax-constipation.locator: Original article, Results, Figure 1 and Table 2. The 4-week constipation analysis uses 60 and 28 participants.
sun-2020-flax-constipation.denominator: Four-week constipation assessment across the flaxseed and lactulose groups (60 + 28). Two of 90 randomized participants discontinued.
sun-2020-flax-constipation.replacedLimitation: Age range and analysis population not established from the abstract.
analysisLimitations: The 4-week constipation analysis excluded two lactulose-group participants who discontinued.
sun-2020-flax-constipation.claimText: The four-week constipation assessment included 88 participants across the flaxseed and lactulose groups.

tea-tree-enshaieh-2007.locator: Original article, Methods, Results and Table 1 (pp. 22–23), 30 per group with all participants completing follow-up.
tea-tree-enshaieh-2007.denominator: Lesion-count and severity analysis across the gel and placebo groups (30 + 30).
tea-tree-enshaieh-2007.replacedLimitation: Small trial; abstract-only extraction; no older-adult subgroup reported.
analysisLimitations: Small trial in people aged 15 to 25.
tea-tree-enshaieh-2007.claimText: The trial analyzed lesion counts and severity across 60 participants in the gel and placebo groups.
